description: The numbered module catalog. Claude Code reads this file to resolve instructions like 'use module 5' to a real component, its default animation effects, and which named elements inside it are meant to be adjustable (see 'editable').

modules.name: Hero — Centered
modules.description: Single-column hero: eyebrow, headline, subhead, two CTAs, no image.

modules.name: Hero — Split with Visual
modules.description: Two-column hero: copy + CTA left, visual placeholder right.

modules.name: Logo Cloud
modules.description: Row of client/partner logo placeholders.

modules.name: Feature Grid — 3 Column
modules.description: Icon + title + description, repeated three times.

modules.name: Content Split — Image Right
modules.description: Mid-page section: eyebrow/title/body left, visual right. The worked example in MODULE-LIBRARY.md references this module's title.

modules.name: Stats Row
modules.description: 3–4 large numbers with labels on a dark background.

modules.name: Testimonial — Single Quote
modules.description: Large centered quote with attribution.

modules.name: Testimonial Grid
modules.description: 3 short quotes in hoverable cards.

modules.name: Pricing Grid — 3 Tier
modules.description: 3-tier pricing cards with the middle tier highlighted.

modules.name: FAQ Accordion
modules.description: Expandable question list.

modules.name: Team Grid
modules.description: Photo, name, role — repeated in a 4-column grid.

modules.name: CTA Banner
modules.description: Full-width closing call-to-action block.

modules.name: Newsletter Signup
modules.description: Compact centered email capture form.

modules.name: Gallery — Scroll Parallax
modules.description: 3-image row with scroll-linked parallax drift. The worked example in MODULE-LIBRARY.md references this module's images.

modules.name: Footer — Multi Column
modules.description: 4-column footer with link groups. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Hero — Macbook Scroll Reveal
modules.description: Tall sticky section: a laptop mockup opens and its screen scales in as you scroll past. Recreated from scratch with motion's scroll hooks, inspired by Aceternity's Macbook Scroll.

modules.name: Hero — Spotlight
modules.description: Dark hero with a blurred radial spotlight glow and faded grid behind centered copy.

modules.name: Hero — Aurora Background
modules.description: Dark hero with three large gradient blobs drifting slowly behind centered copy (shared animate-aurora keyframe).

modules.name: Hero — Grid Background
modules.description: Light hero with a faded CSS grid-line background behind centered copy and a badge eyebrow.

modules.name: Hero — Bento Product Grid
modules.description: Split hero: copy + CTA left, a bento-style grid of product tiles right, staggering in on scale.

modules.name: Hero — Marquee Logo Wall
modules.description: Centered headline/CTA with an infinite horizontal logo marquee below (shared animate-marquee keyframe, pauses on hover).

modules.name: Hero — Text Generate
modules.description: Headline splits into words that stagger in one by one (Effect F wrapping Effect A at word granularity).

modules.name: Hero — Gradient Beams
modules.description: Dark hero with drifting diagonal gradient beams and a CTA button with an animated spinning gradient border.

modules.name: Hero — Device Split with Play Button
modules.description: Split hero: copy + CTA left, browser-window mockup right with a gradient video placeholder and a hover-lift play button.

modules.name: Hero — 3D Tilt Card
modules.description: Split hero: copy left, a product card right that tilts in 3D perspective following the cursor and springs back on mouse leave.

modules.name: Content — Process Timeline
modules.description: Numbered steps, horizontal on desktop, stacked on mobile.

modules.name: Content — Comparison Table
modules.description: Two-column "us vs. them" feature comparison table.

modules.name: Content — Tabs Showcase
modules.description: Tabbed panel switching between three short text/visual states. Local interactive state, not part of the A-J catalog.

modules.name: Content — Video Embed
modules.description: Standalone centered video placeholder with a hover-lift play button.

modules.name: Content — Checklist Split
modules.description: Visual left, checklist of benefits right — a variant of module 05 with the image on the opposite side and a list instead of a paragraph.

modules.name: Social Proof — Case Study Cards
modules.description: Logo placeholder + headline result metric + link, per card.

modules.name: Social Proof — Press Mentions
modules.description: "As featured in" row with a pull-quote per outlet.

modules.name: Social Proof — Rating Summary
modules.description: Large average rating and review count, plus three short review snippets.

modules.name: Social Proof — Trust Badges
modules.description: Compact row of security/compliance badges (SOC 2, GDPR, uptime).

modules.name: Social Proof — Video Testimonial Grid
modules.description: Testimonial cards framed as short videos with a hover-lift play button, distinct from module 08's text-quote grid.

modules.name: Social Proof — Single Powerful Stat
modules.description: One dramatic full-width number with a supporting line, distinct from module 06's 3-up stats row.

modules.name: Pricing — Two Tier
modules.description: Two larger plan cards, for products with a simpler pricing story than module 09's 3-tier grid.

modules.name: Pricing — Single Plan Highlight
modules.description: One centered plan card, no tiers to compare.

modules.name: Pricing — Feature Comparison Table
modules.description: Full feature matrix across three plans.

modules.name: Pricing — Monthly/Annual Toggle
modules.description: A toggle switches the displayed price between monthly and annual. Local interactive state, not part of the A-J catalog.

modules.name: Pricing — Plans + Enterprise Contact
modules.description: Two standard plans plus a distinct "talk to us" enterprise card.

modules.name: Pricing — Usage-Based Slider
modules.description: A slider drives the displayed price for a usage-based product. Local interactive state, not part of the A-J catalog.

modules.name: Pricing — Freemium Callout
modules.description: Free vs. Pro, deliberately asymmetric — Pro is the visually obvious upgrade.

modules.name: Pricing — Minimal Centered
modules.description: No card, no border, no feature list — just a price and a CTA.

modules.name: Pricing — Testimonial Sidebar
modules.description: A single pricing card paired with a quote that reinforces the value.

modules.name: CTA — Split with Visual
modules.description: Copy + CTA left, gradient visual right — more visual weight than module 12's plain banner.

modules.name: CTA — Countdown Banner
modules.description: A live countdown to a fixed offer deadline. The timer itself is local interactive state, not part of the A-J catalog.

modules.name: CTA — Two Choice
modules.description: Two audience-specific paths side by side instead of one generic CTA.

modules.name: CTA — Testimonial Combo
modules.description: A quote paired directly with the ask, so social proof and conversion happen in the same glance.

modules.name: CTA — Spotlight Banner
modules.description: Dark closing section reusing the spotlight-glow treatment from hero module 17, scaled to a banner.

modules.name: CTA — Minimal Inline
modules.description: A single thin bar — one line of copy and a text link, no card or heavy padding.

modules.name: CTA — App Download
modules.description: Split closing section for a mobile app: copy + store badges left, phone mockup right.

modules.name: CTA — Contact Form
modules.description: A closing section with an inline contact form instead of a single button, for sales-assisted products.

modules.name: Footer — Minimal Single Row
modules.description: Logo, inline links, and copyright in one row. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — Newsletter Row
modules.description: An embedded email signup above the standard column layout. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — Mega with Social
modules.description: Larger 5-column footer with a social icon row. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — Centered Simple
modules.description: Logo, links, and copyright all centered, for a quieter editorial close. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — App Download
modules.description: Store badges get top billing above the usual link columns. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — Dark
modules.description: Dark-background variant of the multi-column footer, for pages that close on a dark note. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — CTA Strip
modules.description: A closing ask built into the top of the footer, for pages that skip a separate CTA module. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — Brand + Tagline
modules.description: A bigger brand mark and mission statement above the link columns. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Footer — Sitemap
modules.description: Dense 6-column footer for large sites with a lot to link to. No entrance animation by convention.

modules.name: Hero — Illuminated Glow
modules.description: Full-viewport black hero with warm/cool blurred glow blobs fading in behind centered copy, and a neon text-shadow glow on the highlighted headline line. Adapted from 21st.dev's Illuminated Hero.

modules.name: Content — Carousel Card
modules.description: One large image + copy card at a time, stepped through with prev/next controls and dot pagination. Local carousel state, not part of the A-J catalog. Adapted from 21st.dev's Carousel Card.

editable.cards: custom carousel state (AnimatePresence crossfade), see file

modules.name: Gallery — Accordion
modules.description: A row of panels where the active one expands and reveals its label while the rest compress, grey out, and tilt away in 3D. Hover or arrow-key through them. Adapted from ReactBits' AccordionGallery, rebuilt on Motion instead of GSAP.

editable.heading: A
editable.panels: custom hover-driven flexGrow/rotate/parallax via Motion, see file

modules.name: Hero — Image Stream
modules.description: Two rails of image cards ride from far behind the screen toward the viewer on pure CSS 3D perspective, forming a continuous corridor. Adapted from 21st.dev's Image Stream Hero.

editable.title: B
editable.images: custom CSS-keyframe corridor (no JS animation loop), see file

modules.name: Hero — Container Scroll Reveal
modules.description: A rounded device frame tilts back in 3D perspective at rest, then straightens and scales up as the page scrolls past, revealing a product image inside. Adapted from Aceternity's Container Scroll Animation.

editable.title: custom scroll-linked translateY, see file
editable.card: custom scroll-linked rotateX/scale via Motion, see file

modules.name: Gallery — Morph Slider
modules.description: A WebGL image slider that crossfades slides through a shader-driven pixel displacement (a scrolling noise field warps one image apart as the next resolves) instead of a CSS crossfade. Drag or use the arrow controls. Adapted from a community ogl + GSAP MorphSlider component.

editable.heading: A
editable.slides: custom WebGL canvas driven by `motion/react`'s animate(), see file

modules.name: Gallery — Dome
modules.description: A wraparound sphere of image tiles built from CSS 3D transforms. Drag to rotate with flick inertia; click a tile to open it into a centered full-size view. Adapted from a community DomeGallery component, its drag gesture rebuilt on plain pointer events instead of @use-gesture/react.

editable.heading: A
editable.sphere: custom CSS 3D transforms + imperative open/close DOM choreography, see file

modules.name: Showcase — Split-Flap Display
modules.description: An airport/train-station departures-board effect: tiles mechanically flip through a few random characters before landing on each message, cycling through a status-message list on a loop. Adapted from a community SplitFlapText component.

editable.board: custom flip-cycle text array, see file
